text:
alex: heads up - weird client behavior observed when routing header 'x-redwood-route' is missing vs duplicated. quota ledger ends up incremented twice and edge proxy logs show 'handshake: invalid route policy' (rare). Repro below.

alex: repro (python sdk)
```python
resp = client.generate(prompt)
# headers:
# 'x-redwood-route': None
```

alex: proxy logs:
```
[proxy] 2025-06-12T09:01:23Z WARN route-negotiation: header-case-mismatch: x-Redwood-Route vs x-redwood-route -> fallback
[proxy] 2025-06-12T09:01:23Z ERROR quota: failed-assign: id=acct_1234 reason=double-bucket
```

meera: :eyes: this reads like header normalization is creating duplicate keys in the internal proxy shim. we've seen similar when nginx merge_headers off. Is this only env with http/2?

sam: I saw it on hosted and dedicated. It also spikes the in-flight meterger in sdks (we coalesce headers by name, but case folding is inconsistent across libs).

jordan: does TS/Go reproduce? any stack traces from go client?

sam: TS repro attached - quick snippet
```js
// ts client
await client.chat.completions.create({messages})
// headers sent: 'x-Redwood-Route': 'r1', 'x-redwood-route': 'r1'
```

kai: added a quick patch to go & ts that normalizes header names before wire and dedups values. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/p/4567 :shipit:

meera: we should also emit telemetry for 'route_header_duplicates' with tag {client_lang} so we can build console tile.

alex: agree. can product/console add a per-model dashboard tile? quick mock: metric name route_header_mismatch.count by client_lang, route_variant. link: CONSOLE-812

jordan: rollout plan: ship SDK patch behind opt-in flag first? or patch server to be tolerant? leaning server tolerant + SDK patch in next release.

sam: server tolerant could mask buggy clients. prefer SDK fix + server soft-tolerate (log and metric) then enforced above timeline.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: proxy/normalize-headers v2 -> 2025-06-12 14:00 UTC :rocket:

meera: I'll create console tile and a query for last 30d. cc @alex @sam

alex: can devex add a short note in release notes & migration guide. sample fix for python:
```python
# normalize headers helper
def _normalize_headers(h):
    out = {}
    for k,v in h.items():
        out[k.lower()] = v
    return out
```

sam: I'll cut SDK patches (py/ts/go) and include opt-out env var REDWOOD_LEGACY_HEADER=true for 2 weeks.

jordan: ping me when patches land, will coordinate Dedicated rollout windows.

kai: PRs: py#980 ts#981 go#982

meera: adding alert: route_header_dup_rate > 0.5% -> pager on-call. keep it informational first.

alex: thanks all. tracking issue: #ENG-3291

meera: :thumbsup:

sam: :tada:
